import os
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['MKL_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
import opendssdirect as dss

# Build circuit (text-command DSL)
dss.Text.Command('Clear')
dss.Text.Command('New Circuit.src basekv=12.47 phases=3 bus1=src')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l1 bus1=src bus2=m1 length=3 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l2 bus1=m1 bus2=endb length=4 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.lda bus1=m1 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=700 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldb bus1=endb phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=1400 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('Set voltagebases=[12.47]')
dss.Text.Command('CalcVoltageBases')

# Apply modifications
dss.Loads.Name('ldb')
dss.Loads.kW(2600.0)

# Run analysis
dss.Solution.Solve()
assert dss.Solution.Converged(), 'power flow did not converge'

# Extract result
dss.Circuit.SetActiveBus('endb')
_nodes = list(dss.Bus.Nodes())
_v = dss.Bus.puVmagAngle()
result = _v[2 * _nodes.index(1)]
print(round(float(result), 6))

import os
os.environ['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
os.environ['MKL_NUM_THREADS'] = '1'
import opendssdirect as dss

# Build circuit (text-command DSL)
dss.Text.Command('Clear')
dss.Text.Command('New Circuit.src basekv=12.47 phases=3 bus1=src MVAsc3=20000 MVAsc1=16000')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l1 bus1=src bus2=n1 length=3 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l2 bus1=n1 bus2=n2 length=4 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Line.l3 bus1=n2 bus2=n3 length=5 units=km phases=3 rmatrix=(0.3 | 0.1 0.3 | 0.1 0.1 0.3) xmatrix=(0.7 | 0.3 0.7 | 0.3 0.3 0.7)')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.lda bus1=n1 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=800 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldb bus1=n2 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=1000 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('New Load.ldc bus1=n3 phases=3 kV=12.47 kW=1200 pf=0.92')
dss.Text.Command('Set voltagebases=[12.47]')
dss.Text.Command('CalcVoltageBases')

# Apply modifications
dss.Lines.Name('l3')
dss.Lines.Length(8.5)

# Run analysis
dss.Text.Command('Set mode=faultstudy')
dss.Solution.Solve()
assert dss.Solution.Converged(), 'fault study did not converge'

# Extract result
dss.Circuit.SetActiveBus('n3')
_isc = dss.Bus.Isc()
result = (_isc[0] ** 2 + _isc[1] ** 2) ** 0.5
print(round(float(result), 6))
